fact: Opening a five-day WAPIS data-quality training at CID Headquarters in Freetown on 19 September 2022, the Inspector General of Police said that the WAPIS system, launched in Sierra Leone in January 2022, is not deployed country wide, that this could cause major challenges in collecting data, and asked the European Union to consider supporting its extension to all border crossings across the country.
title: SLP COMMENCES 5 DAYS WAPIS DATA QUALITY TRAINING FOR THE SLP, IMMIGRATION AND ACC OFFICERS
